Ben attached a short runbook paragraph below for Sarah's security reviewer.

--- ben_carter (Solutions) wrote: ---
Redwood runbook excerpt:
- Hosted API: customer tokens may be used for model access; user prompts and responses are stored transiently for 7 days by default with configurable retention. No customer PII should be stored in prompts; for regulated customers we recommend Dedicated or Private where logs/metrics are fully isolated and customer-managed KMS is supported.
- Dedicated: runs in reserved GPU pools; logs are stored in the customer's VPC (or S3 bucket) per contract; control plane metadata is encrypted with customer KMS when requested.

If you want a short diagram, I can paste one into the follow-up doc.
